title: Add PolliArena to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [PolliArena](https://polli-arena.cloudbr.eu.org) to image
- Community-driven model benchmark and blind comparison arena for Pollinations image models with native BYOP (Connect User Wallets). Features: - ⚔️ Blind Battle Arena: Pit two secretly randomized models

Fixes #14590

gist.headline: Let the models duel
gist.blurb: PolliArena has joined the garden: a community-built blind battle ring for Pollinations image models. Bring a wallet, compare the pixels, and let the better mysterious rectangle win.
gist.summary: Added PolliArena, a community-driven blind comparison arena where users can pit secretly randomized Pollinations image models against each other and connect their own wallets through native BYOP.
gist.impact: Users can now discover image-model preferences through side-by-side blind battles in PolliArena, with native wallet connection for bringing their own Pollen credits.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a friendly arena referee watching two retro CRT monitors present anonymous generated-image cards for a blind model battle. The scene should make comparison feel playful rather than competitive, with a small wallet pouch, vote buttons, flowers and code-vines around a cozy garden arena.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with light blue wings, pink blush, black oval eyes, and a tiny referee cap, hovering warmly between two chunky retro CRT monitors in a flower-filled blind image-model battle arena; each screen shows an anonymous pastel landscape card, with a little wallet pouch and pixel vote buttons nearby. Lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently across the garden arena, with code-plants, soft lavender and peach gradients, and subtle CRT scanlines; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
